comparison.objective: Bend copper tube to 90 degrees while compensating for springback.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate a lever bender iteratively, relaxing it to observe irreversible bend state.
comparison.success_condition: Relaxed tube finishes at 87–93 degrees with bender stable and hands clear; overbend fails.
comparison.reason: Tests controlled plastic deformation and feedback from springback, not separation at a notch or cleanup of released pieces.
